proves.claim: The thin show door returns the item, agents and history the full show reads for a plain item.

cli.io-show-thin.plain-item-facts.why: Without it, a regression where the thin show door returns the item, agents and history the full show reads for a plain item would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The thin show door steps aside for any item or board the full show must read.

cli.io-show-thin.steps-aside.why: Without it, a regression where the thin show door steps aside for any item or board the full show must read would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The thin show door steps aside for a board whose shape drifted.

cli.io-show-thin.steps-aside-drifted-boa.why: Without it, a regression where the thin show door steps aside for a board whose shape drifted would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Loading the thin show door pulls in none of the board barrel modules.

cli.io-show-thin.loads-no-barrel.why: Without it, a regression where loading the thin show door pulls in none of the board barrel modules would pass unnoticed.
